description: Luw.ai Pattern AI: generate a seamless, tileable pattern or texture — tiles, wallpaper, fabric, terrazzo, wood, stone — ready to repeat across a surface. Costs 1 credit.

engine.description: Luw.ai model: symphony (Symphony-3, the default: the higher quality) or aria (quicker, for everyday work). If the user picked a model earlier in this conversation, use that one.

image.description: Optional reference image (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

prompt.description: The pattern, e.g. "blue and white Moroccan zellige tiles".

size.description: 512 for a small tile; leave it out for the full size. aria: 1024 px small, 2048 px full; symphony: 512 px small, 1024 px full.

name: luw_generate_pattern
title: Seamless pattern / texture (Pattern AI)
